videre: videō, -ēre, vīdī, vīsum — to see, behold (pres. inf.) · also 3rd pl. perf. (= vīdērunt)
visu: vīsus, -ūs (m.) — sight, seeing (abl. sg.; miserābile vīsū, pitiable to see)
vocate: vocō, -āre, -āvī, -ātum — to call, summon, invoke (2nd pl. imper.)
volucrum: volucris, -is (f.) — bird, winged creature (gen. pl., -um for -ium)
